target.title: fix(line): drop blank entries from trailing commas in agenda/buttons/device directives
target.body:
## What problem this solves

The LINE `[[agenda:]]`, `[[buttons:]]`, and `[[device:]]` directive parsers split their comma-separated lists without dropping blank entries. A trailing or doubled comma in agent output — common in LLM output — produces empty model entries:

- **agenda** → an empty-title event → an empty-string Flex `text` component. The LINE Messaging API rejects an empty text with **HTTP 400**, so the whole agenda card is dropped (message loss).
- **buttons** / **device** → an action whose `label` is empty (also invalid).

The `[[quick_replies:]]` parser already avoids this by routing its split through the shared `normalizeStringEntries` helper (which trims and drops empties); agenda/buttons/device didn't.

Fixes #105380

## What changed

`extensions/line/src/reply-payload-transform.ts`: route the agenda, buttons, and device comma-lists through the existing `normalizeStringEntries` helper (same as `[[quick_replies:]]`), instead of three ad-hoc trim/filter pipelines. One canonical normalization path, no drift.

## Evidence

### 1. Real LINE API — the actual directive-generated payload

`parseLineDirectives("[[agenda: Today | Standup:9am, Lunch:12pm,]]")` output posted to the LINE `validate/push` endpoint (validates a payload without sending; token/recipient redacted):

**Before (current `main`):**
```
altText: 📋 Today (3 events)
HTTP 400 - {"message":"A message (messages[0]) in the request body is invalid",
  "details":[{"message":"must be non-empty text",
  "property":"/body/contents/2/contents/2/contents/2/contents/0/text"}]}
```

**After (this PR):**
```
altText: 📋 Today (2 events)
HTTP 200 - {}
```

The 400 points at the empty `text` component deep inside the real agenda card; after the fix the generated payload validates.

### 2. Source-level reproduction (`parseLineDirectives`, current `main`)

| directive (trailing/doubled comma) | before | after |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `[[agenda: Today \| Standup:9am, Lunch:12pm,]]` | 3 events, 1 empty `text` component | 2 events, 0 |
| `[[buttons: Menu \| Choose \| Opt1:d1, Opt2:d2,]]` | 3 actions, 1 empty label | 2 actions, 0 |
| `[[device: TV \| Box \| Playing \| Play:toggle,, Menu:menu]]` | 1 empty action label | 0 |

### 3. Tests

New regression tests in `reply-payload-transform.test.ts` (trailing-comma agenda/buttons, doubled-comma device). Verified red on `main`, green with the fix:

```
# without fix (origin/main parser):
 × drops trailing commas in agenda events   → expected '📋 Today (3 events)' to be '📋 Today (2 events)'
 × drops trailing commas in buttons actions  → expected length 2 but got 3
 × drops doubled commas in device controls   → expected [Array(6)] to not include ''
 Tests  3 failed | 12 passed (15)

# with fix:
 Tests  15 passed (15)
```

Typecheck (`tsgo -b tsconfig.extensions.projects.json`) clean.
